title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.
We have looked at the labour and material cost developments you describe and appreciate your openness about how they weigh on the foundry. Our proposal responds to these points and confirms a binding volume to support your planning.

We confirm a binding volume of 8150 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our demand forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09).
Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).

On this basis we propose: EUR 125.83 per unit, valid from 2026-11-01, payment 14 days net, for our full demand of 8150 units a year over 12 months.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €133.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate your detailed response, the confirmation of the binding volume of 8150 units, and the proposed 14-day payment terms.
In recognition of the improved payment terms and the confirmed volume, we are pleased to offer a revised price of EUR 133.60 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
